text:
alex.h: Quick sweep before I hand off — can folks confirm status of the postmortem action items from incident #342? I want to make sure nothing blocks overnight coverage.

mira: TL;DR — most items merged, a couple still in verification. Which ones do you want checked now? @sam @lindsey

sam: I can verify the circuit-breaker tuning and the alert threshold changes. I pushed the PR earlier (GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/876).

alex.h: Awesome. The checklist I care about: 1) circuit-breaker thresholds (prod), 2) DB connection leak mitigation (hotfix), 3) runbook updates + playbooks, 4) synthetic test to catch the regression.

mira: Connection leak mitigation is deployed to canary and we saw no FD growth after 30m. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/902. Still need one more hour of canary before promoting to prod.

sam: Circuit breaker changes are live in prod. Alerts adjusted: `err_rate > 0.5% for 5m` -> now `>0.7% for 3m` per postmortem decision. I ran a quick smoke by spiking 50 concurrent failing requests, breaker tripped as expected.

lindsey: I updated the runbook and added the decision tree for fallback to smaller model variant. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/342-fallback. Also noted the metric to watch: `model_latency_p99`.

alex.h: Nice. Can someone run the synthetic test and paste results? The test should exercise the specific sequence that regressed: long prompt + streaming enabled.

sam: Running now. Command I used: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-medium-v2","prompt":"<long>...","stream":true}' | jq -c '.duration_ms'
```
Will paste times in a sec.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: infra/pr-876 promoted to prod by @sam at 1799058120 — status: success :white_check_mark:

sam: Results: p50=120ms, p95=340ms, p99=780ms. No obvious memory/FD spike during 15m. Synthetic runs look stable.

mira: Canary for DB leak has completed 1h — promoting to prod now. Noting slight bump in connection churn during promotion but normalized.

alex.h: Thanks. That addresses the DB and circuit-breaker items. Two remaining: synthetic test in continuous job and final runbook signoff. Who will own adding the synthetic to the cron suite?

lindsey: I'll add the test to the nightly suite and create the cron job entry. Will open PR and tag review. ETA tonight 23:30 PT.

mira: Runbook signoff — I left two inline comments on the doc about escalation contacts. @lindsey can you incorporate?

lindsey: Yep, will resolve Mira's comments and mark it approved.

alex.h: Perfect. One more: postmortem has a TODO to revisit load-testing thresholds during next capacity planning. Adding a follow-up ticket would be good.

mira: Created ticket INF-1182 for capacity planning review and linked postmortem.

sam: All items tracked: infra PR merged, runtime PR merged, deploy ok, synthetics pending (Lindsey), runbook edits pending (Lindsey). No reopen needed from my view.

alex.h: Great. I'll hand off to @lindsey for overnight coverage — she's got the checklist and the followups. Lindsey — any concerns picking this up?

lindsey: Happy to cover. Only ask: if latency p99 > 1s or error rate > 1% for 5m, escalate to oncall-sre and start rollback to rwd-medium-v1 per runbook. I'll be online until 02:00 PT, then @mira will take the next shift.

mira: Confirmed. I'll be on for the morning.

alex.h: Thanks all. If anything flares up overnight, please post to #incidents and ping pager|slack. I'll be reachable but won't be on primary.

lindsey: Quick note: I ran `kubectl top pods -n prod` and will watch memory/CPU for model pods. If anything looks off I'll trigger the canary rollback.

sam: Adding a tiny post-check script for the grep of FD counts: 
```
#!/bin/bash
for p in $(pgrep -f rwd-model); do
  echo "pid:$p fds:$(ls /proc/$p/fd | wc -l)"
done
```
I'll drop this into infra/monitoring so ops can run it quickly.

deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly maintenance window tonight 23:30-00:30 PT — non-disruptive network patch.

lindsey: Good to know, I'll avoid promotions during that window.

alex.h: All right — leaving this thread open for any late updates. Thanks for the quick checks and PRs.

mira: Thanks everyone. :heart:

sam: thx :thumbsup:

lindsey: will update once synthetics PR is merged.

alex.h: handoff complete.
